stages: Generate canonical set partitions of six labelled vertices once.
For each partition evaluate which of the ten copied triples are monochromatic.
Aggregate by allowed-edge mask and block count, then superset zeta transform to counts for every edge-deleted subhost.
Retain complete partition records, every coefficient row, size/chromatic profiles and work counters.
Native-blob checkpoint the entire result before any saved reader call.
new_work_only: No source red/blue edge-coloring, old ZDD operation, forbidden-K4 census or selected-mask rank is invoked.
interpretation: Labelled palette count is sum_k c(H,k)*(q)_k. This is a finite hypergraph capability and no obligatory/uncountable-chromatic theorem.
reader_failure_policy: Bank each request before query and each returned response, complete caches and work immediately; outer catch retains all progress. Zero count schedules no selection.
